title: FreeCast Hires Ericsson Veteran Eddie Bryan, Bringing More Than 25 Years of Experience in Global IT Operations and Cybersecurity - Press Release - FreeCast
summary: Appointment strengthens technology leadership in enterprise infrastructure, security policy and risk management to support FreeCast’s expansion across telecom and enterprise markets.
body_markdown:
ORLANDO, Fla.- FreeCast, Inc. (NASDAQ: CAST), a provider of streaming technology and branded media platforms, today announced the hiring of Eddie Bryan. Bryan brings more than 25 years of experience at Ericsson spanning global IT operations, enterprise infrastructure integration and cybersecurity leadership, including more than a decade as IT Enterprise Cyber Security Manager.


The appointment adds experienced technical leadership as FreeCast pursues broader deployment of its Platform-as-a-Service offerings for telecommunications providers, internet service providers, multifamily communities and major consumer brands.


At Ericsson, Bryan’s responsibilities included identity and access management, cloud security, threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management and third-party vendor security. His experience encompasses security architecture across Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure and cloud-based software environments, along with the application of NIST and ISO 27001 frameworks.


Earlier in his Ericsson career, Bryan led global IT operations teams responsible for enterprise infrastructure integration, system configuration and service delivery. His combined operational and cybersecurity background brings experience in both connecting complex technology environments and managing the risks associated with those connections.


For FreeCast’s partners, this experience is relevant throughout the deployment process, from evaluating security requirements and integrating systems to managing access controls and preparing incident-response procedures. Organizations offering entertainment services under their own brands must consider how those services interact with their infrastructure, customer relationships and operational requirements.


“Eddie brings more than 25 years of experience at Ericsson, where his responsibilities spanned global infrastructure, IT operations and enterprise cybersecurity,” said William Mobley, founder and CEO of FreeCast. “That experience matters to partners entrusting their brands and customer relationships to our platform. His appointment strengthens the technical leadership supporting our enterprise deployments and long-term partner relationships.”


Bryan’s appointment is intended to support FreeCast’s ongoing work in cybersecurity strategy, cloud and infrastructure protection, security governance and operational risk management. His experience developing enterprise policies, technology roadmaps and technical teams is also relevant to addressing the requirements of larger distribution partners.


FreeCast’s PaaS enables organizations to offer media and entertainment experiences under their own brands. The platform brings together free and paid streaming choices, content discovery and subscription management across supported devices, allowing partners to add entertainment services to their existing customer offerings.


“Cybersecurity is a core consideration for organizations evaluating technology they will offer to their customers,” Mobley added. “As we pursue larger distribution relationships, our technology capabilities and operational discipline must develop together. Eddie’s experience will help guide that work as we build the foundation for broader deployment.”


**About FreeCast, Inc.**


FreeCast, Inc. (NASDAQ: CAST) provides streaming aggregation technology and Platform-as-a-Service solutions that enable organizations to deliver branded media and entertainment experiences. Its platform connects content discovery, free and paid streaming options, and subscription management across supported connected devices.
